en.headline: Customs seizes 10 endangered live turtles at airport from US parcel
en.dek: Officers found the suspected scheduled species inside a carton declared as women's knitted tops; the case was referred to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.
body: Hong Kong Customs today seized ten live turtles of suspected scheduled endangered species with an estimated market value of about HK$20,000 at Hong Kong International Airport.

Through risk assessment, officers intercepted a parcel declared as containing women's knitted short-sleeve tops arriving from the United States. Upon inspection, the batch of live turtles was found inside a carton box.

The case has been handed over to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department for follow-up action. Under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, importing specimens of endangered species without proper authorisation carries a maximum penalty of a HK$10 million fine and 10 years' imprisonment, with the specimens forfeited.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢10隻懷疑瀕危活龜 來源美國包裹
zh.dek: 關員在報稱載有女裝針織短袖上衣的紙箱內發現該批活龜，案件已交漁護署跟進。
body: 香港海關今日在香港國際機場檢獲10隻懷疑受管制屬瀕危物種的活龜，估計市值約2萬元。
經風險評估，關員截查一個由美國寄往香港、報稱載有女裝針織短袖上衣的包裹，在紙箱內發現該批活龜。
案件已轉交漁農自然護理署跟進。根據《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》，任何人如非按照規定進出口或管有瀕危物種，最高可被判罰款1,000萬元及監禁10年，有關物品亦會被充公。
